title: Specifications for internal homogeneous cochain coordinates
statement: For a commutative condensed ring $A$, its internal module category and internal action category, an internal-function presentation $F$ and a family of bar diagrams [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data], retain the following existing definitions unchanged. For a tuple $g$ of $n$ group-valued continuous sections let its prefix tuple have entries $1,g_1,g_1g_2,\ldots$; for $x$ of length $n+1$ let its successive quotients be $x_i^{-1}x_{i+1}$. A homogeneous section is an internal-function section on $J^{n+1}$ whose evaluations on every slice satisfy $c(a x)=a c(x)$ for the given internal action [def-sfb-condensed-action-module]. A homogeneous cochain presentation is a coefficient-functorial nonnegative complex with sectionwise injective maps to these function modules, image exactly the homogeneous sections, and alternating-deletion differential. The coordinate specification consists of such presentations for all profinite groups, natural isomorphisms to the given inhomogeneous bar complexes with the two stated evaluation formulas, normalized degree-zero coefficient isomorphisms, restriction maps with evaluation by precomposition and both coordinate squares, and the induced isomorphism after extension by zero and the ordinary localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Universes are those of [def-weil-size-convention], rings and modules those of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. This node only relocates the existing definitions; it introduces no new mathematical notion or assertion.
